Release notes · v0.001

KD102 invites you into the journey. A new silent closing card invites your feedback throughout the trip. The app’s More tab is now Help Shape What Comes Next. Tour 102 follows Chervil’s traveler app. Eleven animated chapters introduce the real sections, dates, daily memories and trip tools. Both start gates, speed controls, captions and chapter jumping are available.

The suitcase rolls in automatically and waits for Let’s Unpack. The instruction card waits for Let our journey begin. Space: play or pause · ← / →: skip 10 seconds · Speed buttons work on iPhone, Android, and desktop browsers.
